title: Gauntlet 1
description: Objective quality under pressure — math word problems, structured extraction, and multi-constraint instruction following, all machine-graded. Quality dominates the composite 3:1 over performance.

reference.label: synthetic-1
reference.notes: v1 anchors the 1000-point scale to round-number synthetic baselines (0.85 accuracy, 100 tok/s decode, 3000ms p95) rather than a measured reference rig. A future suite version will re-anchor to measured hardware; per the versioning rules that resets the leaderboard.

tasks.prompt: A store sells pencils for $0.35 each. Maria buys 14 pencils and pays with a $10 bill. How many dollars of change does she receive? Respond with only the final number.
A train travels 180 kilometers in 2.5 hours. What is its average speed in kilometers per hour? Respond with only the final number.

A rectangle is 9 centimeters long and 4 centimeters wide. Its width is increased by 25 percent while its length stays the same. What is the new area in square centimeters? Respond with only the final number.

Tom reads 12 pages on Monday. On Tuesday he reads twice as many pages as on Monday. On Wednesday he reads 8 fewer pages than on Tuesday. How many pages does he read in total across the three days? Respond with only the final number.

Read this passage: 'Dr. Elena Vasquez, 47, has spent two decades as a marine biologist and now leads a research lab in Lisbon.' Respond with only a JSON object with exactly these keys: name (string), age (number), profession (string), city (string). No other keys, no commentary.

Read this passage: 'Order TK-4821 for 12 ceramic mugs was placed on March 3 and has already been shipped to the customer.' Respond with only a JSON object with exactly these keys: order_id (string), quantity (number), shipped (boolean). No other keys, no commentary.

Read this passage: 'The first World Expo, known as the Great Exhibition, took place in London in 1851 and drew six million visitors.' Respond with only a JSON object with exactly these keys: title (string), year (number), city (string). No other keys, no commentary.

Read this passage: 'Published as a 312-page paperback, The Glass Harbor by Naomi Chen remains one of the decade's most borrowed library books.' Respond with only a JSON object with exactly these keys: title (string), author (string), pages (number), format (one of the strings "hardcover", "paperback", or "ebook"). No other keys, no commentary.

Write a short product announcement (3-5 sentences) for a reusable water bottle called HydraPeak. Your announcement must mention the product name 'HydraPeak', the phrase 'BPA-free', and the phrase 'lifetime warranty'.
Write a short introduction (3-5 sentences) for a pasta recipe. Your introduction must mention the words 'basil', 'garlic', and 'olive oil'.
Write a short travel blurb (3-5 sentences) about visiting Japan in spring. Your blurb must mention the words 'Kyoto', 'temples', and 'cherry blossoms'.
Write a short job posting (3-5 sentences) for a senior frontend developer. Your posting must mention the words 'remote', 'TypeScript', and 'health insurance'.
